meta_description: Randy's Auto Repair serving Dunn - auto repair that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: Auto repair in Dunn, without the runaround.
hero_lede: Auto repair in Dunn. Call and we will take a look.
card_about: Who you are calling, and the work we do in Dunn.
quote_h2: Tell us what is going on with the car
about_p1: Our work covers diagnostics and check engine work, engine repair, brakes, and transmission and drivetrain for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: We work out of Dunn and the towns around it.
area_h2: Serving Dunn and the towns nearby
svc_hero_h1: The auto repair work we take on

services.title: Diagnostics and check engine work
services.body: The fault gets traced to its actual cause before anything is replaced, so you pay for the part that failed and not the three beside it.

evidence.text: After fixing it I was driving to work and the check engine light came back on.

services.title: Engine repair
services.body: The engine comes apart far enough to find the actual fault, not far enough to run up the bill.

evidence.text: Took my 2006 ram 1500 to randy for some engine repairs, and electrical repairs.
evidence.also: They did my brakes, my rotors, the head gasket job transmission, and also water pump.

services.title: Brakes
services.body: Pads, rotors and calipers are checked as a set and the worn ones come off beside the new ones, so you can see what was actually changed.

evidence.text: They did my brakes, my rotors, the head gasket job transmission, and also water pump.
evidence.also: I needed my brake pads replaced.

services.title: Transmission and drivetrain
services.body: Shifting problems are diagnosed on the road and on the lift before the case is opened, and rebuilt units go back with fresh fluid and seals.

evidence.text: They did my brakes, my rotors, the head gasket job transmission, and also water pump.

reviews.author: Anthony Tudor
reviews.text: First and foremost he had it 5 months before I even got it back then It is left me so many times I can't count I paid him $12,800 to put a motor in my truck and this is what I get been back to the shop 5 times and his continue to let me down they had the nerve to charge me $650 even though they were the ones to do the work to begin with in the gas tank they charged me for a gas tank ring and seal set up anyway. I gave them every dime including borrowing $200 from my cousin because my life depends on this truck. Breaks down again three days later I had to hobble it halfway back home by the sheer love of a good friend of mine's mother she gave me a vehicle to use to get me home lie to me and told me they were sending a tow truck that would be there within an hour Monday morning I show up to wait for Randy personally he never shows up his boy behind the counter I'm sending someone out to fix it right now on the side of the road yes on the side of the road told me they replaced the part all they did was unhook back pressure sensor drive the truck today leaves me stranded 2 miles from my house. This is what they have done to me time and time again I hope this helps somebody it sure as hell ain't helping me. What good is a warranty if they couldn't even fix it to begin with Included picture of text message Monday morning at 9:30 where he lied to me and told me he was sending the tow truck over there

reviews.author: Sarrina Bancroft
reviews.text: The most professional and respectful shop that I’ve ever used. They did amazing on my Dodge Durango. They fixed absolutely everything for a reasonable price. My truck was messed up by another mechanic and they were able to fix everything plus the other work and got my Truck on the road within just a couple days running amazing brand new thank you to them for saving me Some money and helping me have a vehicle to provide transportation for my free children again very grateful to them. Anybody needs any work I definitely recommend 10 out of 10. They did my brakes, my rotors, the head gasket job transmission, and also water pump. I wouldn’t trust any other shop with my work again. I will always go back to them.

reviews.author: Peggy
reviews.text: I found Randy's on Google and the reviews were excellent. I needed my brake pads replaced. In and out within an hour at half the price the dealership quoted me. I will gladly refer them and be a repeat customer. Thank you

reviews.author: Heather Yale
reviews.text: If you're looking for an honest and reliable auto shop in Dunn, look no further than Randy's Auto. They recently fixed a tricky issue with my car that another mechanic had misdiagnosed. The team was straightforward and didn't try to upsell me. The repair was done quickly, correctly, and for the exact price they quoted. Randy's Auto is my new go-to for all car troubles, they've earned my trust completely. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Steven Anderson
reviews.text: Randy and his wife Renee run the best garage in the area. They’re a Christian family that has always gone out of their way to fit me in to get either my diesel truck or one of our cars serviced or repaired. From major work to minor jobs he’s always been reliable and given prices that are half what the dealer charges. He is professional, knowledgeable and friendly. Thanks for always helping in a time crunch and doing quality work Randy!

reviews.author: Jodi Lynn
reviews.text: Our 16 yr old found this shop and took his truck there. They worked him in quickly, found the issue, gave us recommendation and we thought it was going to be 2x as much as it was. They were great and I highly recommend them. Great rates.

reviews.author: Yesica Matute
reviews.text: I am more than satisfied with the job they did. Before coming here I had gone to Toyota because I had 3 lights come on. I was charged over $500 stating that it was the battery and what so. Literally that same evening the same lights came on. I took it again to Toyota and they said it could be the timing belt which had already been replaced within the year. Once I heard that I knew they did not know how to fix the issue. After much resesrch I took my car to Randy's auto repair. They told me that it would need a tune-up and replace the ignition coil. It has been a little over a month and the lights have not turned on. They knew what the issue was and fixed it pretty quick. They have gained a customer. Thank you so much and may God bless your establishment!

reviews.author: Jamie DeLuca
reviews.text: I want to sincerely thank Renee and Randy for their professional and timely response for my axle replacement in my Toyota Camry. They coordinated vehicle towing and repaired as stated. A job well done and I highly recommend Randy's for your auto repair needs...Jamie DeLuca

reviews.author: Brittani Williams
reviews.text: Tire bearings went out in the middle of our trip. With 8 people in the vehicle and no one close we had to make a major decision. We called all over the area and without much luck could not find anyone. After calling Randy and Renee, they both made me feel super welcomed, ordered our parts and worked with us on pricing due to everything being unexpected. and finished the job in under 3 hours! This is a great great great family owned business! They will forever be our vehicle family. And a special thank you to Caleb for his hard work on getting Betsy back on the road.

reviews.author: Tina Diggs
reviews.text: I came to Dunn NC from Dothan, Alabama to rent a U-Haul and the company would not rent to me without a connection device on my vehicle, I called around everywhere and no one could get to me on that Friday, I stopped by Tractor Supply in A nearby city when one of their employees told me about Randy’s Automotive in Dunn, North Carolina. I called Randy and spoke to him personally and explained my very volatile situation about my lights, he told me not to worry come on out and he could get me fixed right up. Randy got my adapter hooked up in just a few hours and did an excellent job with a very reasonable price to add! His staff is very friendly and professional, his office Manager Robert was pleasant and treated me like family, and speaking of family I met his beautiful wife Renee and handsome boys to top it off. As a small family operated business I highly recommend Randy’s Automotive to anyone looking for car care in the surrounding area, Randy delivered what I needed and I was back on the road in no time to head home to sweet Alabama!

reviews.author: Raegan Hedges
reviews.text: From the moment I called for a quote I was treated amazing. My car has been having trouble for a long time. I’ve been to several mechanics with no luck. The crew at Randy’s would not give up until they found and fixed the problem. They were really there for me. 100% recommend this shop. The lobby is beautiful, I didn’t have to wait long at all but if I’d had to I would have been very cozy. 1 happy customer

reviews.author: Eric Mederos
reviews.text: Quality service by a professional team! Randy and his team did an excellent job with my vehicle. From the beginning, Randy was very informative about what steps the shop would take to repair and provided regular updates throughout the process. Highly recommend everyone in the area take your business to Randy’s. You won’t be disappointed.

reviews.author: Gustavo cruz
reviews.text: Took my 2006 ram 1500 to randy for some engine repairs, and electrical repairs. kept shutting off on me and had some electrical components not working right, both times I took my truck for service I was 100% satisfied with the outcome. They fixed my issues fast and are very reliable, they are friendly people that treat you well and are easy to communicate with. If you’re looking for a trustworthy and great mechanic I highly highly recommend Randy’s.

reviews.author: Hopper Kremer
reviews.text: Randy worked quickly and methodically to diagnose the electrical issues with my blinkers and radio grounding in my TJ Wrangler. All of his workers were very friendly and the vibe was great in general. Very impressed!

reviews.author: Stan Goodwin
reviews.text: Wish I could give 10 stars. I was in a bind last week with my truck. The turn around was quick. Had my car towed in on Thursday. It was ready to go Friday morning. If you are thinking about taking your car here just do it. Prices are good. I was actually giving a transparent and pretty accurate estimate. Due to the nature of the issue it caused secondary repairs. They where knowledgeable enough to factor that in. Both of the shop owners are amazing to work with. The communication was amazing. They turned a stressful experience into a pleasurable one.

reviews.author: Teresa Snodgrass
reviews.text: We take all our vehicles there to be worked on. Very hard working and honest people. They guarantee their work. I would highly recommend them to anyone who needs any mechanic work done. Very clean shop, friendly atmosphere. Mr Randy and Mrs. Renee and the whole crew are awesome, very respectful, honest people.

reviews.author: JAMES STRADLEY
reviews.text: I took my Chevy Suburban to get fixed. The crew and front office here are absolutely awesome!!! After fixing it I was driving to work and the check engine light came back on. I contacted them and for the next 2 days they picked me up and took me to and from work until they could assess what else was going on. Once an additional issue was found they fixed it and now I am back on the road and she runs like brand new. Thank you to Randy, Robert, and the other guys in the shop that put a lot of time and sweat into getting me back on the road.

reviews.author: Raegan Hedges
reviews.text: Randys has helped me feel confident and safe driving my car. I found their prices fair and they treated me more like family than a customer. They also helped me with getting a care card set up for an auto emergency. I dont know what i would have done without their care.

reviews.author: bob barton
reviews.text: One of my driv. He called around the next morning and found Randy's shop and they were willing to take a look at it the same day. I received a call from him explaining the problem and what was needed... he quoted me a fair price and was able to get my driver back on the road the same day. I truly appreciate fine folks like this and highly recommend them to everyone. Bobhad a problem after making a delivery in Fayetteville

reviews.author: Teresa Byrd
reviews.text: I recently had work performed on our BMW at Randy’s Auto Repair. He came highly recommended by my brother Jim Byrd. I must say that the experience was exactly as stated. The estimate and work performed was flawless. Price for work was VERY reasonable considering dealer cost and estimates from other shops. Work was performed as stated, nothing extra was done without contacting me first. Car was repaired and ready to be picked up as stated....I was/am impressed with the value that you receive from here. It is nice to know there is a repair shop that does what they say and will not leave you wondering what was done. Very informative as to what work was performed and why. Randy’s Auto will be where I take all my personal vehicles for any repairs as well as our HVAC business vehicles (TWO AMIGOS HEATING and AIR). Thanks Randy! John Byrd

reviews.author: Linda Fritsche
reviews.text: Very nice folks..Randy and his staff are very professional and this man does not stop until you are truly satisfied...Good Christian people who really are here for their customers...and do care about their customers.. they went completely out of their way to make sure I was happy...And I have to say if you want honesty and good work by good people this is THE place to take your vehicles...I HIGHLY RECOMMEND RANDYS AUTO!! If I could truly rate them five stars are just not enough. Linda Temple

reviews.author: James Moose
reviews.text: Will always take my Vehicle to Randy's. He really knows what he is doing so does his Employees. They take there time and does the Job right. 100%. Randy and his Employees are some of the nice people I've ever met. Thank you.

reviews.author: James Moose
reviews.text: Randy his wife and all of his employees are all down to earth all around great people. I wish there were more people in the world just like them. I've never met any better people. They helped me when I couldn't find any help and that means everything. Thank you so much for everything. 10 Stars

reviews.author: Lindsay Irvine
reviews.text: I cannot speak highly enough of the entire team at Randy's! I bought my first used car, which was a Mercedes, and within two months it turned into a nightmare! Thank God for the team at Randy's! Considering all that was wrong, they were extremely reasonable and so very courteous! If all businesses operated in the manner in which they do, the world would be a better place!

reviews.author: Kenny Judd
reviews.text: Great people! Had a LS swap done and I can’t complain..as with any time you do a complete swap with any engine there are going to be little things to be adjusted..anything I needed I just called and let them know and there was no question ask was told to just bring it by and we will take care of it ..the only ppl I’ll let touch my truck ..thank you Randy

reviews.author: Christal Beckley
reviews.text: The best place in town. Awesome owners and friendly staff. They take care of their customers. Everything is done in a timely, professional manner. Very well priced. I recommend Randy’s Auto Repair to anyone!!

reviews.author: Maria Quijano
reviews.text: Tremendous, they helped us and fixed the car,the same day, even though they closed at 6:00 pm in the afternoon. Very good service.

reviews.author: Zachary Taylor
reviews.text: These are some good, honest people. every time I bring my CRV in they do a great job and communicate throughout the whole process. I will never take my cars anywhere else. thanks guys!

reviews.author: Pharris Johnson
reviews.text: Randy did a great job on my A/C Pricing was very fair everybody Should let Randys Auto Repair Work on there car or truck. God Bless them forever for helping Repair my 1992 F-150 A/C.

reviews.author: Dawn Wilkes
reviews.text: Randy and his staff are awesome. Very accommodating and knowledgeable. They will not fix an issue until they contact you and let you know what's going on. They are very trustworthy and honest. Just all around good people!

reviews.author: Tiffany Curran
reviews.text: I had the best experience here with getting it done in a timely fashion and the friendliness of Randy and his wife. They definitely treat you like family.

reviews.author: Karsyn Fann
reviews.text: Do NOT hesitate to take your vehicle here. I had a wonderful experience with Mrs. Renee and Mr. Randy! Will never take my vehicle anywhere else.

reviews.author: Doug Sparks
reviews.text: On my way to Florida at 3:30AM i had what turned out to be a fuel pump go bad.Having a German made vehicle breaking down ANYWHERE is not fun.Randy, the owner of Randy's Auto knew i had a long drive ahead he not only repaired my car to FULL satisfation he had 1 of his very polite and professional employees give me a ride to a hotel so i could get some well needed rest a differant polite and professional employee brought my COMPLETED car to me.WOW what an good experience for an unfortunate expierience. P.S. (Purple Power) Im sure y'all know what i mean. A happy customer Doug Thanks God bless

reviews.author: Amos Love
reviews.text: Home town service from trusted friends. Whether you need a car checked out that you are looking to buy or service on one you drive, this is the place to go. Randy and his team are awesome!

reviews.author: joseph hinson
reviews.text: This is a great community shop! Randy and Rene take care of their customers and stand behind their work. Always eager to help and get you the best prices for whatever you need.

reviews.author: Betty Riddle
reviews.text: Randy's Auto is a very good company to take your vehicle to for repair or service. They are very professional, courteous, and knowledgable.. I highly recommend their company.

reviews.author: Ricky Wiggins
reviews.text: If you need your car or truck fixed and great customer service this i s where you should go! They will find the problem and fix it right the first time. Thanks Randy's Auto repair

reviews.author: Robert Lee
reviews.text: Wanna thank Randy’s Auto Repair for a job well done.Any trucker in need of repairs,Randy’s Auto Repair is who you wanna call.They are fair and honest.I guarantee that you enjoy the conversations with Mr.Robert.Thank you guys for the southern hospitality and great repair service.

reviews.author: Lee Kish
reviews.text: My younging playing with my phone and gave you a 1 star... but let me tell u... they service is fast friendly and professional... i got lots more work to complete with them... it was worth the drive for 48 minutes to get to them... thank you so much

reviews.author: Jack Littleton
reviews.text: Honest , trustworthy, dependable, prompt service without any problems. Best auto repair business around. Thanks Randy!!

reviews.author: Davia Cochran
reviews.text: I loved the people and environment of this shop. Everyone was so nice, professional, and helpful in my time of need. I will definitely be coming back for future services and will recommend this place to others. 10/10

reviews.author: Henry Yale
reviews.text: What an amazing family. I highly recommend these folks. Great atmosphere. They were completely honest with prices, and quick.

reviews.author: Brian Cook
reviews.text: They fixed my car when no one else could. Very reasonable price. Very friendly people. A bit hard to find. Very far east of Dunn.

reviews.author: Melissa Schaber
reviews.text: Very pleasant experience all way round. Awesome people and great company to do business with. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Brett Boling
reviews.text: This is by far the best garage I've ever been to, they got my stuff fixed quick and to satisfaction.

reviews.author: Karl Faison
reviews.text: Great Christian business. No matter what the issue is, Randy, Renee and their crew, can fix it! Electrical or mechanical.

reviews.author: Corey Daniels
reviews.text: Great honest business. Fast service and friendly courteous employees who I’ll continue to bring my vehicles to.
